registered_in: PROTOCOL.md §5, before INE publishes ECAPSH 2026 (expected September 2027)

P4_imm_vs_reception.A: sign(ΔIMM occupied) = sign(Δ reception places, Dec-2024 -> Dec-2026), scored only if |Δ reception| >= 10%

deviation_D1_2026_10_04.note: PROTOCOL.md §12, D1. Clarifies scoring; the registered intervals above are unchanged.
deviation_D1_2026_10_04.q1: ln(o_core,2026 / o_core,2024), o = occupied per centre offering accommodation, core = GBV+OTH
deviation_D1_2026_10_04.q1_oth: the same with core = OTH only
deviation_D1_2026_10_04.q2: core occupancy 2026 minus 2024, percentage points (occupied adults / all places)
deviation_D1_2026_10_04.reading_A_falsified_iff: per_centre_pressure OR (P4 scored AND P4 sign mismatch, on occupied and on places)

verdicts.A supported: no_per_centre_pressure AND P4 scored AND P4 = A on both occupied and places
verdicts.no per-centre pressure; A and growth thr: no_per_centre_pressure AND (P4 not scored OR P4 mixed)
verdicts.A rejected on P4; no per-centre pressure: no_per_centre_pressure AND P4 = mismatch on both
verdicts.undetermined: any other combination (stated, with the values)

deviation_D1_2026_10_04.P3: reported, not used in the verdict
deviation_D1_2026_10_04.P4_places_variant: sign(ΔIMM places) against the same reception change; reported with P4
deviation_D1_2026_10_04.classification_break: if INE changes the specialisation item, the ETHOS-based scope, the adults-only rule or the reference dates, all values are reported and the verdict is 'not scored (classification break)'
